ff..e: Abbreviation of Latin foliō (“on the (next) page”), ablative of folium (“leaf, page”).

d.g: A type of superconducting phase, characterized by the presence of Cooper pairs with nonzero center-of-mass momentum and a spatially non-uniform superconducting order parameter.

FFLO phase.e: From the initials of the names of the physicist theoreticians who predicted this superconducting phase: Peter Fulde, Richard Ferrell, Anatoly Larkin, and Yuri Ovchinniko.

d.g: Elongated form of fu (clipping of fuck).
d.x: "Fffffffuuuuuuuuuuuu!" I yell. It hurts my ears.

fffffffuuuuuuuuuuuu.e: Elongated form of fu, a clipping of fuck. The specific elongation length was coined on Reddit in December 2008, in reference to rage comics on 4chan earlier in 2008. 7 "F"s and 12 "U"s are used as a reference to the /r/fffffffuuuuuuuuuuuu subreddit or its community. The term is sometimes shortened to f7u12.
